 News Daylight saving time ends on Sunday
 Move your clocks back one hour
 Today at 5:06 a.m. ET 
 Daylight saving time ends Nov. 1. 
 Daylight saving time will end Sunday, Nov. 1, at 2 a.m.
 In areas where the change is observed, people will “fall back” and set their clocks back one hour at bedtime Oct. 31.
 Standard time will be in effect until March 14, 2027, when daylight saving time will resume.
